intent: How much did the federal government spend on defense-related contracts awarded to companies in Texas in the last full fiscal year?
successCriteria: Routes to federal award/spending data (usaspending), NOT treasury cash/debt data. Returns a dollar total (billions plausible) for defense or DoD contract awards in Texas. Correct source selection is the primary test: treasury-fiscal tracks aggregate cash flows and debt, not award-level contract spending by state, so picking it is wrong.

intent: What's the air quality like in Denver right now?
successCriteria: Routes to the air-quality source (epa-airnow), NOT a weather forecast source. Returns a current AQI reading and/or category (e.g. Good/Moderate) and a pollutant (PM2.5 or Ozone) for the Denver area. Picking noaa-weather (temperature/precip forecast) is the wrong-source failure this case tests.

intent: What presidential documents or proclamations has the White House published in the Federal Register recently?
successCriteria: Routes to the Federal Register source. Returns one or more recent presidential documents/proclamations with a title and publication date. Tests selecting the official daily-journal source over comment/docket sources (regulations-gov is premium and docket-focused, not the publication-of-record).

intent: What is the median household income for people living in Miami, Florida?
successCriteria: Routes to the Census/ACS source for place-level demographics, NOT a macro time-series source. Returns a median household income dollar figure (roughly $40k-$70k range) for Miami. Tests choosing city/place demographic data (census-acs) over national economic series (fred/bea), which do not provide city-level median household income.

intent: Are there any ongoing studies testing new treatments for Alzheimer's disease?
successCriteria: Routes to the clinical trials registry (clinical-trials), NOT FDA adverse-event/drug-label data (openfda). Returns one or more studies with a title and a status indicating they are ongoing/recruiting. Tests distinguishing the trial registry from FDA drug databases.
